exposure: six-session, telephone-based couple-based intervention training relationship skills
cohort: 21 couples co-parenting a child with cancer who were randomized to a couple-based intervention or education control.
finding: The couple-based intervention demonstrated high feasibility (56% participation, 82% post-intervention survey completion, 62% session completion) and acceptability (mean satisfaction = 3.3/4), though changes in other measured outcomes were small and mixed in direction between the intervention and control groups.
